note: Deterministic-engine parity corpus. Each case is run through the Python deterministic path (no LLM) AND its ABAP twin; both must reproduce the same fields/notes. Only guards that fire without a model are covered (checksum, e-signature, statement period, JP form, doc_type classification) — narrative-field guards (VIGILADO bank_name, model-misplaced numeric IBAN) need the model and are covered by unit tests, not here. Fake IBANs are mod-97 valid.
